name: Arrogant Animals
source:
You and your dog Dongdong wake up in an unknown forest. a talking chicken, a restaurant serving uncommon meat, two strange villages: Caution and Choice. How will you return to the original world?

[From [url=https://kangzhixuan.itch.io/arrogant-animals]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和爱犬Dongdong在一片陌生的森林中醒来。会说话的鸡、供应奇特肉食的餐馆，以及两个古怪的村庄——“谨慎”与“选择”。你该如何回到原来的世界？

[摘自[url=https://kangzhixuan.itch.io/arrogant-animals]itch.io[/url]]
